label: Sign, biased exponent and fraction
subgoals: Subtract the bias from the exponent field
Prepend the implicit leading one to the fraction
Multiply the significand by the power of two and apply the sign

label: Encoding a value
subgoals: Normalize the value to a significand between one and two
Add the bias to the power of two
Scale the fractional part of the significand by two to the fraction width

label: Spacing, subnormals and special values
subgoals: Compute the ulp as two to the unbiased exponent minus the fraction width
Decode exponent field zero as subnormal without the implicit one
Decode the all-ones exponent as infinity or NaN
